floorPlans.note: Confirm the signed layout and total area for the specific residence. The presentation gives average sizes across types. A public five-bedroom penthouse drawing has yet to be confirmed.

review.images: All eight images are from Aldar’s official Mandarin Oriental launch. The gallery shows the development, arrival, residences and the penthouse terrace. The Zayed National Museum appears in context and is identified as such.
review.location: Physical page 9 places the residences beside Zayed National Museum. The three estimates are from the project-specific OPR page. No surveyed entrance coordinates.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all 27 physical presentation pages. Pages 15–17 supply full unit sheets and pages 19–20 supply building floorplates. The additional JRE two- and three-bedroom drawings have different geometry from Aldar’s examples. The OPR four-bedroom corner with pool is shown as a single attributed illustration. The JRE five-bedroom link displays an on-request notice. The broker-supplied Madena PDF contains the same three launch layouts and two floorplates, so is omitted. Published averages are excluded from individual plans.
